title: Specialized outlets share their weekend playthroughs in recurring recommendation sections
summary: Nintendo Life, Eurogamer, and Rock Paper Shotgun publish their regular columns about what their editors are playing this week.

title: Former Old School RuneScape developer sentenced for stealing $400,000 in virtual gold
summary: A former Jagex employee was sentenced after an eight-year investigation for stealing in-game items and currency to sell them illegally.

title: Valve intentionally leaked Left 4 Dead 2 cinematic trailer to bypass ESRB censorship
summary: The game's writer confirmed the company released the video on its own after the rating board refused to approve its graphic content.

title: BioWare veteran says pessimism about Mass Effect 4 is exaggerated and studio doesn't need advice
summary: A former studio designer defends the team's ability to deliver the new installment without external interference.

title: GTA 6 boosts Xbox and PlayStation stocks as details leak about its refueling mechanic and open-world design
summary: The game's announcement pulled consoles out of the red, and new reports reveal refueling will take about 10 seconds and that Rockstar may draw inspiration from Zelda, though unlikely.
